cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't think they let me win the race, do you? I taught you to save something for the last straight; you saw me do it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A decent observation. Now finish it: they couldn't keep my pace. You used to stop your race reports just before giving anyone credit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One stopped to tie a shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine stayed tied. I showed you that double knot before your first race; preparation counts. Tell me I earned the finish, not that someone donated it.
